title: buxus cordata
intro: Buxus cordata, commonly known as the Korean boxwood, is a species of flowering plant in the family Buxaceae. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including the reduction of inflammation and the improvement of cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Buxus cordata include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antispasmodic, and diuretic, making it useful in treating a range of health issues. The bioactive constituents of Buxus cordata include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
